Subject: Ground transportation plan & vendor selection for SF onsite (Feb 24-26)

Team —

We have the TradeCorp onsite scheduled for Feb 24-26 at their SoMa office. I put together a quick spreadsheet (attached) with options: rideshare credits, dedicated car service (SUVs for execs), rental car block, and two parking approaches (valet at venue vs. self-park permits). Can you take a look and flag any must-haves or hard constraints from your side by EOD tomorrow?

Key constraints I know so far:
- TradeCorp execs want SUVs for airport transfers (SFO arrivals on 2/24)
- Finance prefers consolidated invoicing where possible (one PO/invoice to Redwood)
- CS/PD will need a small shuttle between the hotel and venue during workshop days

I think our options are:
1) Lyft Business credits for general attendees + Lyft Lux SUV for exec pickups (cheaper for ad-hoc)
2) BlueOak Car Service (local vendor) for all executive transfers + shuttle for attendees (flat daily rate)
3) Rental car block for onsite staff + reimburse employees for parking — more admin work for expense team

I've highlighted tradeoffs in the sheet: cost, liability, invoice flow, and county parking rules. Please comment in the sheet or reply with your picks. If we go with a car service we should loop in procurement this week — BlueOak needs a PO and 48-hour lead.

Attachments: ground-transport-options.xlsx

Thanks,

Thanks all — quick procurement/finance checklist from my side: 

- We prefer a single vendor invoice where possible to reduce AP work. BlueOak's willingness to invoice Redwood directly is good.
- Please request BlueOak's W-9, proof of insurance, and standard service agreement. Accounting will also need a remit-to address and invoice template (Samantha mentioned she can supply these).
- For rideshare credits: smaller groups (under 30) are usually cheaper using Lyft Business for ad-hoc attendee rides, but Lyft cannot guarantee SUVs for specific pickup times — that's why BlueOak is preferable for named execs.
- Parking permits: if valet is available at venue, procurement can cover a bulk parking pass under the event PO. If staff are reimbursing individual parking, we'll have to process expense reports which adds ~5 days to reconciliation.

Action items:
- Laura: confirm with Samantha that BlueOak can provide W-9 + insurance docs and send sample invoice to acct@redwood.com.
- Monica: confirm guest counts and specific SFO arrival windows for the execs (I need flight numbers to match pickup times).
- Vivek: confirm hotel -> venue shuttle schedule needs (start/end times).

I'll prep a PO draft after we have the vendor documents.
